claim: Every supported request reaching route dispatch has one exact CRLF request line, unambiguous bounded origin-form target, HTTP/1.0 or HTTP/1.1 version, strict raw header pairs and framing; mutation bodies pass UTF-8, JSON and route-specific schema validation before application dispatch.

requestLine.separator: exactly one ASCII SP between each of method, target and version
requestLine.methods: nonempty HTTP token; supported dispatch methods GET, POST; HEAD remains a valid token with its existing 501 rejection
requestLine.target: origin form beginning with exactly one slash, ASCII URI characters or complete percent escapes; no raw fragments, backslash, controls, space, non-ASCII or escaped C0/DEL/backslash
requestLine.termination: exactly CRLF, no embedded CR or LF
requestLine.normalization: no stdlib double-slash rewriting; target is preserved exactly

headers.input: ordered raw_items pairs, retaining duplicate occurrences; DeadlineReader has already enforced line, aggregate, count, CRLF and no-fold bounds
headers.syntax: nonempty ASCII token name; values contain HTAB or codepoints 32..126 or 128..255; no CR/LF/NUL/DEL
headers.host: exactly one for HTTP/1.1; optional singleton for HTTP/1.0; DNS/reg-name ASCII letters/digits/dot/hyphen/underscore/tilde or bracketed IPv6; optional decimal port 0..65535, at most five digits; no credentials, path, whitespace or comma
headers.contentType: if present application/json with optional unique charset=utf-8 or utf8 (case insensitive), optionally quoted; no unknown, empty or duplicate parameter; required on mutations
headers.contentLength: absent means zero; otherwise 0 or 1..8 canonical decimal digits without sign or leading zero; nonzero rejected on nonmutations

json.bodyBytes: positive and <= route byte limit; exact read length before decode
json.encoding: strict UTF-8, no BOM or lone surrogate
json.grammar: CPython json.loads grammar with duplicate decoded object keys rejected at every depth, nonfinite constants and floating overflow rejected
json.depth: container nesting <= normalized json_depth (root object counts as depth one), strings and escaped quotes do not add depth
json.schema: existing public/admin route schema validation precedes service/engine dispatch; unknown-field policy is route-specific

requiredWitnesses: six baseline socket breaches reject after repair without route dispatch
valid HTTP1.0 without Host and HTTP1.1 browser GET/HEAD/JSON POST preserve behavior
raw and encoded control, fragment, bad escape, absolute and authority targets reject
Host missing/duplicate/empty/invalid port and credentials reject
nested duplicate JSON keys, depth overrun, malformed UTF8, surrogates, nonfinite values and top-level arrays reject
source guard removal, regex widening and primitive substitution are rejected by bridge or independent proof
trust: CPython ordinary exceptions and primitive bytes/string/list/dict/int operations
CPython re.fullmatch implements the extracted closed regular-expression language; no extension or callback regex features are admitted
CPython ipaddress IPv6Address implements literal IPv6 recognition only
CPython strict UTF8/json parsing and JSON serialization primitives; application duplicate/depth/finite/top-object policies are source-bound separately
stdlib raw_items retains field multiplicity after the source-bound raw-line lexical checks
bounded exact socket reads and sampled deadlines are separate source-bound obligations
excluded: HTTP2/3, proxy absolute-form, CONNECT authority-form, OPTIONS asterisk-form, HTTP0.9
arbitrary Python monkeypatching or hostile runtime replacement
